i.norm: The Discordian chronology only customises the value range for a fixed set of date-based fields (day-of-month, month-of-year, year, ...). For any other field, {@link DiscordianChronology#range(ChronoField)} falls back to the field's own range. MINUTE_OF_DAY is a time-based field that is not special-cased, so the call must still return a non-null range (the default one supplied by the field itself).
